title: Kaya Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Kaya is a 4 BR / 3.5 BA / 10 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Enjoy picturesque moments relaxing on the spacious covered porch, while you reminisce about the day's adventures or make evening plans.
description_expanded: Description712 FOREST STREET1 KING, 2 QUEENS, 2 TWINSExtensively Renovated Seaside Cottage with Park ViewsKaya has undergone extensive renovations throughout the home, featuring all-new designer furnishings, upgraded finishes, and beautifully renovated kitchen and bathrooms. This thoughtfully refreshed Seaside cottage is ideally located within walking distance of the community’s beaches, pools, tennis courts, dining, and shopping—making it an exceptional choice for a relaxed yet convenient Seaside, Florida vacation.Oversized porches span the length of the home on both levels, overlooking a peaceful wooded park and creating a private, serene setting. The downstairs porch is perfect for enjoying morning coffee in Adirondack chairs or rockers, while the upstairs screened-in porches offer multiple seating areas and outdoor dining just off the main living space.Primary Suite Retreat with Luxury BathThe king-sized primary suite is a true private oasis, featuring upscale finishes, new designer furniture, a large mounted flat-screen TV, and a stunning renovated ensuite bathroom. The spa-like primary bath includes a dual vanity and an impressive multi-stream rain shower. With direct access to a screened-in porch, the primary suite offers a tranquil retreat ideal for couples seeking both comfort and privacy during a family getaway.Comfortable Guest Bedrooms for FamiliesThe first level of the home includes two additional bedrooms designed with families in mind. One bedroom features two twin beds, while the second offers a bright queen bedroom filled with natural light. These guest bedrooms share a conveniently located hall bathroom and open onto a large screened-in porch with rocking chairs—an inviting space for quiet mornings, evening conversations, or winding down with bedtime stories.Open-Concept Living, Dining & Renovated KitchenThe second floor serves as the heart of the home, featuring a newly renovated kitchen with all-new appliances, breakfast bar seating, and ample counter and cabinet space for beach-day snacks and family meals. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining area, which comfortably seats eight, making it perfect for shared meals and gatherings.Adjacent to the kitchen is a bonus built-in desk area, ideal for remote work or planning daily Seaside adventures. The spacious living room is outfitted with all-new furnishings, including a large sectional sofa, additional seating, and a mounted flat-screen TV. French doors lead directly to the furnished screened-in porch, where outdoor dining and lounging can be enjoyed any time of day or night.Outdoor Living & Prime Seaside LocationWhether you’re grilling, rinsing off in the outdoor shower after a beach day, relaxing on the porches, or taking a short walk to Seaside’s renowned amenities, Kaya offers everything needed for a memorable coastal vacation. Thoughtfully designed for comfort, connection, and relaxation, this cottage blends modern updates with classic Seaside charm.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3 night minimum Fall | 2 night minimum WinterFEATURESFeatures 2,142 square feetBeach Access: 352 yards or a 5-minute walk to the West Ruskin Pavilion, offering access to Seaside’s largest private residential beaches on 30AOutdoor Living: Furnished outdoor dining area and screened-in porches off each bedroomPrimary Suite: King bedroom with private ensuite bath featuring a rain showerWork-From-Home Friendly: Dedicated office desk area for remote workPeacock Alley Linens: Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeResort Amenities: Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityGuest Services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Carts: Two parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo Pets AllowedSTR23-001931
